key_findings: ACT001 binds the TLR4 co-receptor MD2 (Kd 2.8 uM) and destabilizes it.
ACT001 blocked LPS-induced TLR4/MD2/MyD88 complex, NF-kB and MAPK signaling and cytokine expression in BV-2 cells, and attenuated CCI allodynia in rats.
